cards.prompt: What does the fake endpoint return?
cards.long_answer: A fixed quiz read from a JSON fixture bundled with the app, so UI tests are deterministic.

cards.prompt: How long does the fake endpoint take to respond?
cards.long_answer: About 300 milliseconds, so progress indicators are visible in tests.

cards.prompt: Which launch argument enables UI-test mode?
cards.long_answer: -UITestMode. It switches the app to an in-memory store, seeded fixtures and the fake provider.
In AIQuiz/Resources/TestFixtures, bundled as a folder resource.
FakeLLMClient in the LLMKit package, introduced in PLAN Phase 1.
